Run 172 was the manual backup vote at 2026-09-23T13:24:45Z (T-10.6h, k=14, expected $4,914.87, tx 0x12e20b6c215b30551a3704c5950d9d26c219a83f2815a8fc95f261e96fdd3010). Boundary monitor triggers were T-240/T-60/T-35: phase 1 = run 173 (broadcast 23:56:33, T-207s, k=6, $1,647.25, tx 0x4902261bb4fd53944ee9b57bbb926d6e1efe5ab27e1e6b22dadc1a3d212ef42b), phase 2 = run 174 (23:59:19, T-41s, k=4, $1,557.44, tx 0x9d23a578f8a15370c1210d661a00821aed4c7c709e30b79f1f6ea9bd6b9a0ea4), phase 3 = run 175 (23:59:45, T-15s, k=7, $1,521.72, tx 0x766940690f787ff04d3af1bbb2660b2cf12ab02cc82b217dbde6e4d8845bb6c2). Run 175 is the binding executed allocation. Fifth consecutive epoch in which all three phases landed.
notes.dedupe: The operator UI printed 14 lines for 10 distinct tokens. WETH and USDC each appeared three times: a combined line (WETH 0.029538 / $79.32 labelled FEE BRIBE; USDC 1,115.91 / $1,115.74 labelled BRIBE FEE) followed by its two components (WETH FEES 0.011916 / $32.00 and BRIBES 0.017622 / $47.32; USDC BRIBES 1,033.77 / $1,033.61 and FEES 82.1423 / $82.13). Components sum to the combined line in both cases, to the cent. Summing every printed line would give $2,729.00. The deduped total is $1,533.94 against the operator's stated $1,533.93, a one-cent display rounding. Note this is the opposite shape to epoch 1789603200, where the UI printed only split lines with no combined row and the convention was to sum them; here the combined row is present and the components must be dropped instead.
notes.headline: Realised $1,533.94, a new record and 1.91x the prior best of $802.33 ($0.8457 per 1k votes against $0.4424). Against run 175's send-time expectation of $1,521.72 that is +$12.22 (+0.8%); against its realized-at-boundary entitlement of $1,536.99 it is -$3.05 (-0.2%). All 10 reward tokens reconciled to the entitlement at a 1.0000 amount ratio, so there were no missed claims.
notes.token_reconciliation: All 10 tokens match on amount to four decimal places of ratio (1.0000 each). The -$3.05 against the boundary entitlement is price drift between the vote-time snapshot (ts=1790207766, ~3.9 min before the boundary) and the operator's claim-time marks, and it ran marginally against us. Largest movers: WMTX -$2.10 (-9.7% on price), GYND -$0.86, cbBTC -$0.50, VVV +$0.35, WETH +$0.28. No token moved more than 10%. The reconciliation returned 10 rows for 10 tokens with no phantom +/- pairs, so the token_metadata symbol backfill added in 1993c04 is holding; it repaired 4 NULL symbols on this run (GYND, SIBYL, sUSDVE, BLUECHIP) before the join.
notes.dedupe_confirmed_on_chain: The on-chain entitlement independently confirms the dedupe. The review computed expected amounts from boundary_reward_snapshots without seeing the operator table, and returned WETH 0.029538 and USDC 1,115.894663 - matching the combined lines, not the naive sum of all printed lines. Had the three WETH rows and three USDC rows each been summed, the claim would have been booked at WETH 0.059076 and USDC 2,231.82, roughly double, and the total at $2,729.00 against a true $1,533.94.
notes.price_staleness: Zero of the 227 tokens carrying boundary rewards had a token_prices row older than 24h at vote time. Second consecutive clean epoch on this measure.
notes.opportunity_gap: The review's headline gap of $363.87 (22.17%) is boundary_opt against the T-1 prediction, not against what we executed - it is a measure of how much the T-1 forecast missed, and the T-1 prediction was unusually poor this epoch ($565.07 predicted against $1,277.75 realized). The executed gap is $104.63 (6.4%): reachable boundary optimum $1,641.62 at k=31 against run 175's realized-at-boundary $1,536.99. The denylist cost only $5.01 this epoch ($1,646.63 unrestricted against $1,641.62 reachable), far below last epoch's $39.77, because the three large denylisted gauges are already heavily voted (0xac396cab carries 11.5M votes) and our 1.81M would dilute them below their headline $/1k.
notes.k_tolerance_cost: The auto-k tolerance remains the largest controllable item, and it cost more this epoch than last. Run 175's sweep peaked at $1,584.42 (k=49); --auto-top-k-return-tolerance-pct 5.0 selected the smallest k within 5%, which was k=7 at $1,521.72, giving up $62.70 (4.0% of send-time max) by design - against $38.26 last epoch. The curve reaches within 1% of max at k=16 ($1,570.27), and k=20 gives $1,577.54. Tightening the tolerance to 1% would have picked k=16 and captured $48.55 of the $62.70. Note the sweep chose k=7 here against k=14 in the 13:24 backup vote, so the tolerance rule is also making the selection unstable epoch to epoch.
notes.phase_landing: All three phases landed for the fifth consecutive epoch, on the 60/35 spacing: phase 3 broadcast at 23:59:45, T-15s. Send-time expectations fell across the phases ($1,647.25 at k=6, $1,557.44 at k=4, $1,521.72 at k=7) as later refreshes saw more competing votes arrive.
notes.carryover_check: No carryover. The epoch-1789603200 pot was claimed and swapped on 2026-09-17. Token amounts this epoch are not supersets of last epoch's - the two overlap only in USDC, WETH, cbBTC and wtFGI, and wtFGI fell from 12.357 to 7.486 - confirming these are epoch-only lines.
notes.claim_swap_outcome: Claimed and swapped 2026-09-24. Claim ran --claim-source escrow explicitly: 52 of 52 escrow batches successful, one bribe contract per tx. Gross received $1,533.97 against the $1,533.94 table - every one of the 10 tokens landed at a 1.0000 amount ratio and the 3-cent excess is rounding in the displayed amounts. No transfer tax this epoch, unlike the 1% fBOMB tax last epoch. Neither skip-list token (oHYDX, fBOMB) appeared in this pot, so all 9 non-USDC tokens were swappable. The router-batch swap delivered 436.053461 USDC for 9 legs marked at $418.20, an execution of +4.3% - the marks were stale to the upside rather than the swap being cheap, and it reverses last epoch's -2.0%. Every leg cleared completely: zero residual dust in all nine tokens. End state 1,551.967735 USDC in the signer and nothing else retained. Total value captured $1,551.97, i.e. 1.2% ABOVE the marked pot rather than the usual slippage loss. Gas for the whole run was 0.000458 ETH (~$1.23): 0.000307 for the 52 claims, 0.000151 for the approvals and the single executeSwaps. Swap tx 0xac621e3da1a7b6b9a8d0378d9e0edb2fa99eecc71bc02f1c2526435dce290585.
notes.swap_mode_note: --swap-mode defaults to HYDREX_SWAP_EXECUTION_MODE, which is unset, so the tool's own default is 'direct' (one tx per leg). Every prior epoch has run router-batch by passing the flag explicitly. That divergence between the documented practice and the default is a trap: a run that omits the flag silently changes execution method. Consider setting HYDREX_SWAP_EXECUTION_MODE=router-batch in .env so the default matches the practice.
notes.reclaim_guard_note: The already-claimed guard again blocked the swap-only run, which touches no claim path, so --force was needed for Phase 4 exactly as last epoch. Unchanged wart.
